u.ftVNS: My father called me to the settlement [Sovetskaya Rechka].
He told me to come.

u.txVNS: hурурэвун эдук дюктэ эр гулэлдуло̄ ньēскӣ.
u.ftVNS: The two of us went from here to the settlement [=to the houses] downhill.
That is, the children stayed in the chum [tent].
The wolves had been coming before.
There were traces of them.

u.txVNS: Гулэлдӯ, там о̄кӣ — три, илалдава бичо̄вун.
u.ftVNS: In the settlement, there how many — three, three days we were there.
Then we arrived by helicopter.
There were no children in the chum.
My dog [was lying there].
I came over there.

u.txVNS: — hата, — гундем, — вертолеттула̄ эда̄и эчэ эмэрэ?
u.ftVNS: “Well”, I thought, “why didn't [the dog] come to the helicopter?”
Then, when the helicopter flew away, I went — next to the lean-to, by the lean-to [the dog] was lying.
u.txVNS: Потом, вертолет дэгилчалан, hурум — нэ̄ку, нэ̄ку дагин hукулэ̄дирэн.

u.ftVNS: I went, went to look.
It was bitten.
I didn't look at anything on it.
Thing is, probably the dogs had bitten it when they fought.
At Gosha's place, they probably fought and bit it.
So, then I took a good look at it that night:
The thing is with her, she's torn, she's done what-do-you-call-it.
I didn't get it.
I had other dogs, we had three dogs.
One, the biggest one, was there, the others were not there.
“Well”, I thought, “Gosha probably has them.”
Gosha had them.
They stayed in the settlement.

u.txVNS: Потом, потом уже тылим, тылим, как только гунэ рациялӣ, hанӈӯктам.
u.ftVNS: Then, later I realized, realized, as soon as they said on the walkie-talkie, I asked.
Are there any dogs, at Gosha's place?
I asked — nowhere there were any dogs.
Then I went along the shore of the Soviet lake.
I set out to see their tracks.

u.txVNS: Ичэм: волка удялин тадӯ везде ча̄гит.
u.ftVNS: I saw it: the wolf tracks are everywhere, on that side not far away.
I was walking along the shore.
I went farther.
He came [=walked] from there.
He was circling.
Then later there I started asking.
And Gosha doesn't have my dogs there.

u.txVNS: Ну, значит, гуним, тар чипка̄н дяваттэн.
u.ftVNS: So, I thought, that wolf had snatched them.

u.txVNS: Потому что илмактал бичо̄тын сами ӈинакир.
u.ftVNS: Because they were the youngest dogs.
They're nowhere to be found.
The wolf must have killed them.
Probably ate them one by one.
Where else would they go?
